desc.en: Using Verna's Special Skill immediately activates her Passive Trait effects. / Her Special Skill's range changes, and its total DMG increases by 20%.
A 20% Crit Rate boost is added to Verna's Passive Trait effects and their duration increases by 2s.
The skill levels of the Basic Attack, Switch Skill, Special Skill, and Ultimate Skill increase by 2. / Increases Basic Attack DMG by 6%.
While Passive Trait effects are active, using a Basic Attack again after the Basic Attack's 5th Hit will chain directly to the 4th Hit.
The skill levels of the Basic Attack, Switch Skill, Special Skill, and Ultimate Skill increase by 2. / Increases Special Skill DMG by 6%.

Verna's Passive Trait effects' duration increases by 1s, and it increases by an additional 1s when defeating an enemy with a Fire attack. This effect can trigger 1 time every 0.5s. / While Passive Trait effects are active, Verna's Basic Attack's 5th Hit DMG increases by 100%.
